name: StackAI
tagline: No-code platform to build, deploy, and manage enterprise AI agents.
description: StackAI is a no-code platform for designing, testing, and deploying AI agents and automated workflows that act across enterprise systems. A drag-and-drop builder wires LLMs to 100+ integrations, with human-in-the-loop oversight and model flexibility. It ships across managed cloud, VPC, and on-premise deployments.
insight: Acquired by Asana for ~$75M (announced May 28, 2026); a Y Combinator W23 startup whose founders joined Asana.
edge: Enterprise no-code agent builder with VPC/on-prem deploy and SOC 2/HIPAA/ISO compliance — now backed by Asana's work platform.
cons: Roadmap now tied to Asana integration
Crowded market vs Zapier and AI labs
